method: Fnew=F/(1-alpha*delta_CPU/T); alpha=1 low, 1.5 high are sensitivity assumptions, not a confidence interval. No patch or new FPS measured. Budgets may fail; do not add overlapping rows.

rows.name: division_no_normalization
rows.assumption: Observed quotient/cycle model; assumes normalized scratch and V dead, no new guard/glue.

rows.name: width4_width5
rows.assumption: Budget: 35..55 cycles gross per target; 5-cycle dispatch per width>3. Requires code in same bank/RAM, no per-leaf switching.

rows.name: geometry_commands
rows.assumption: Budget: save 20..45 cycles for each of 45 points, subtract 40 per invocation for banking.

rows.name: interpolation_lookup
rows.assumption: Budget: net 200..350 cycles saved per call including lookup setup/banking; arithmetic verified, assembly cost unverified.

rows.name: fill_late_rows
rows.assumption: Budget: 15..35 cycles net for 501/2436 columns starting after row32; no extra per-column banking.

rows.name: layout_pages
rows.assumption: Assume 25..65% observed page penalties removable, no other path regression; all penalties would be an upper bound.

rows.name: multiply_lookup
rows.assumption: Budget: 20..45 cycles net; reuse interpolation table, exact residue/flags still unresolved.

rows.name: sound_dispatch
rows.assumption: Budget: remove 2..5 cycles from 14-channel scan per VBI; preserve event order and hardware writes.
